title: Crop cell fitted to a constant 84dp but drawn in weight(1f), clipping the red outline at narrow panel widths
detail: Real cell is ~76dp at PanelMinWidth (outline right edge clipped, worked: 79.7 of 84) and ~149dp at PanelMaxWidth. cropWindow KDoc claiming the pad changes only on a different display is inaccurate. Clean fix is a measured cell width handed to cropWindow, since doing the arithmetic in the composable is what TAC-4 forbids.

title: ClearStaged keeps promptOverride, resurfacing a prompt for deleted annotations
detail: Same defect class as F-1. ClearStaged empties the annotation list which flips hasPayload false, so the Prompt block leaves composition and RCR-1 staleness effect never runs. EditPrompt(String?) now provides the clearing mechanism, so the fix is a one-line reducer change.

title: matched is exactly tag != null at every call site and defaults false, dimming the tree for forgetful consumers
detail: Collapse to a derived value or default it from tag.

title: Tautological test: assertEquals(1, PAYLOAD_FORMAT_VERSION)
detail: Asserts a literal against itself and would pass under any edit. The constant itself is planned scope (plan says rendered nowhere); the test is the defect. Assert something behavioural or drop it.

title: Test name and comment claim a structural property the body does not assert
detail: Body asserts Empty -> empty twice. Same self-referential failure mode that produced two of this specs three defects.

title: core/payload file names do not partition their contents
detail: One label function in PayloadLabels.kt while two live in PayloadEstimate.kt; PayloadGate.kt now holds three unrelated predicates (hasPayload, hierarchyOutlineDisplay, promptSeedIsStale).

title: ROOT CAUSE: promptOverride carries no record of the payload it was authored against
detail: Nothing can distinguish a stale override from a deliberate one, so F-1 and F-4 fixes are both heuristics for that missing field. A PromptOverride(text, seededAgainst) contract would close both and delete promptSeedIsStale. Contract change, needs its own task and gate.

title: Kotlin/Native release linker OOMs under ~4 parallel linkReleaseFramework tasks
detail: Java heap space against a 4 GiB daemon heap; --max-workers=1 is the workaround and was used for every cross-target gate on this spec. Fix is kotlin.native.linkerThreads or a higher daemon -Xmx. Pre-existing, not introduced by this spec, and affects every future cross-target gate in this repo.

title: EmulatorModel.toRow sets no detail, unlike DeviceModel.toRow
detail: Information gap in the device picker as well as the prompt; AVD name and API level are known. Cross-spec: belongs to android-device-discovery-mirroring and its own gate. Does NOT replace RCR-2s formatting-boundary guard, which must stay because MirrorRow.detail defaults empty, selectedRowDetailWithoutTransport ends in orEmpty, and transport-stripping can legitimately empty a detail.
